data.name: Arkelia - The Fragile Inheritance
data.detailed_description:
"The world won’t end... but the Republic might."

Welcome to 1936. The dust has barely settled on a devastating civil war. The streets of Arkelia are scarred by clashes between rival political groups. The economy is choked by debt, the military operates as a state within a state, and across the northern border, a hostile dictatorship is preparing to march.

The Republic is fracturing. And you have just been appointed Chancellor.

In Arkelia: The Fragile Inheritance, you take on the role of Kurt Baumann, the leader of a fragile, deeply divided coalition government.

The Weight of the Chancellery is Yours

  • Navigate a Divided Cabinet: You do not rule alone. Manage a government of ambitious reformers, cynical industrialists, and ruthless nationalists. Will you build a repressive police state, or push for democratic reforms?

  • Balance a Bankrupt Economy: Wrestle with a massive national debt, stagnant wages, and an autonomous military budget that threatens to consume the entire state.

  • Maintain Public Order: Choose how to handle rising political extremism. Rely on local police, deploy your own loyal security forces, or unleash the army to restore order.

Gameplay Features

Arkelia: The Fragile Inheritance features deep, integrated systems to help you manage the crisis within the nation.

  • Choose Your Path: Featuring countless branching paths and story decisions, make the choices which will either bring your country stability or sink it into chaos.

  • Budget Management: Navigate an economic system where you must manage unemployment, inflation, interest rates, and structural budgetary deficits to deliver recovery.

  • Parliamentary Mechanics: Every law must pass the Arkelian parliament. Wield your influence, negotiate compromises with faction leaders, and manage the party whips to get your agenda passed.

  • Military Strategy: As border threats escalate, the scars of the previous war leave the Federal Army in a state of high alert. Coordinate mobilization, manage army deployments, and prepare a defensive strategy to survive.

  • Your Choices Matter: Every decision has an effect on the story. You are Kurt Baumann, a man with a complex past and his own secrets to reveal. Shape his desicions and actions.

Can you drag Arkelia out of the abyss? Or will you be the architect of its final destruction?

data.short_description: As Chancellor Kurt Baumann, steer a fragile republic through the aftermath of a civil war. Balance a divided cabinet, manage a bankrupt economy under military pressure, and face the looming threat of Nortelorian invasion. Will you save the Republic, or destroy it?
